locked_semantics: mwrank uses 2-descent to determine rank and then saturates known points to a full Z-basis when output generators are requested.
The homogeneous-space point-search logarithmic height bound defaults to 10.
The documented command-line option '-b N' changes that bound; the source explicitly gives '-b 12' as an example.
The documentation advises not normally exceeding 15 and states that a descent may remain conditional when an everywhere-locally-soluble homogeneous space has not been proved to have a rational point.
stage34_policy: Run the default bound first. Only when the explicit unconditional full-Mordell-Weil-basis marker is absent, retry that exact curve at bounds 12, 14, then 15. Accept rank credit only on an attempt containing the explicit unconditional marker and no saturation/rank warning. If all attempts remain inconclusive, fail closed and send the model to a different proof route.
